products.name: Monday.com AI
products.note: Work OS AI; project automation; cross-functional data; Israeli data transfer considerations

profile_text.body:
monday.com describes itself as an AI work platform designed for both people and AI agents working together. The company positions its platform around the idea that AI agents require context before acting, and it emphasizes built-in enterprise-grade infrastructure covering data privacy, governance, permissions, and compliance. The platform is presented as a single environment for executing, managing, and operating work across teams.

The company's tracked AI product is Monday.com AI, categorized under notes, knowledge, and meetings, which incorporates project automation, cross-functional data handling, and considerations around Israeli data transfers. monday.com offers pricing tiers covering small and medium businesses, enterprise customers, and nonprofits, alongside an app marketplace and around-the-clock support.

monday.com is a publicly traded company listed on a stock exchange under the ticker MNDY, with SEC CIK number 0001845338. No litigation or MCP server registrations are currently held in the site's records for this company.
